decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line sits close to the core portfolio, and its certification investment and multi-model breadth create sunk costs that management will want to justify, even though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises some doubt.

The marine cooling unit was visibly committed through its own page and fits the marine direction, so weak results are likely blamed on the temporary marine downturn, though dropping the related box cooler line makes it more exposed.
The multi-model compact oil cooler line builds on established know-how and represents development investment that management will defend by continuing it, despite little recent website visibility.
Finned tubes are a core component feeding the firm's air cooler business and were publicly showcased, so withdrawing them would contradict earlier commitments.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes embody the firm's announced R&D and efficiency direction, so management stays committed and attributes any shortfall to temporary market conditions.
